about_the_game:
HORROR SHOW
Dark Arts and Deeper Decks

A descent into shadow. Five powerful Limited Legendaries lead this pack, including Sigillum Dei and the iconic Plague Doctor. With bonus draws from Tarot, The Occult and Horrible Halloween, this is a toolkit for players who like their decks dark, unpredictable, and unnerving.

Use this to unnerve, outlast and outplay. With twisted synergy and a flair for the theatrical, these cards are built to unsettle - and win.

  • Sigillum Dei (Limited Legendary)

  • The Fool (Limited Legendary)

  • Lich (Limited Legendary)

  • Iron Maiden (Limited Legendary)

  • Plague Doctor (Limited Legendary)

  • 6 random Tarot cards

  • 6 random The Occult cards

  • 6 random Horrible Halloween cards

  • 3 exclusive avatars

content_descriptors.notes: What can we say, reality gets a little mature sometimes. Everything in CUE is based on real-world history, science, art, and myth. If you can’t hack Chronos’ penchant for baby-eating (in text form), this probably isn’t the game for you.
